note: The practice model is deterministic. Two passes of all 30 questions matched. The checks do not read the seconds field, which is only a timer. The nine lines in runs.sample.jsonl match those passes on the same questions. passed and failure_classes are one fresh pass of all 30 questions. sample is the score of runs.sample.jsonl. The partial-answer check also flags an answer whose lines are only a symptom, an issue link, or a generic debug tip. That flags practice runs 10 and 13, so 8 of 30 pass and PARTIAL_ANSWER is 12.
